UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Publish recurring, canonical-first tutorials, benchmarks, and migration guides through an Infragistics DEV Organization.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Top owned priority: build a consistent Infragistics DEV publishing program with canonical technical content.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Use as a branded engineering publication or secondary channel for searchable technical guides—not announcements.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Top secondary channel: syndicate or publish searchable engineering guides through a branded publication.

UITools_Placements.Audience: Software developers, AI builders & engineering leaders
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Lead with an ungated benchmark, guide, or demo. Test TLDR Dev first; use TLDR AI only for a strong AI/MCP story.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority: run a paid TLDR Dev pilot; reserve earned outreach for a major, newsworthy release.

UITools_Placements.Audience: Enterprise software buyers, users & procurement teams
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Claim one profile per sellable product, complete all details, and build an ethical verified-customer review program.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority: claim complete product profiles and launch an ethical verified-customer review program.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Pitch a timely JS/TS release, OSS sample, benchmark, or migration guide with a direct link and clear developer value.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority: test sponsorship with a strong JS/TS benchmark or release; submit editorially when timely.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Focus on measurable front-end gains—performance, accessibility, or bundle size—with runnable code and before/after results.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority: sponsor measurable UI performance or accessibility content with runnable examples.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Pitch a React-specific demo or benchmark around virtualization, accessibility, server-side data, or performance.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority: best Cooperpress option for React; lead with a React grid demo or benchmark.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Use short, developer-native copy built around one pain point or surprising result, linking to a useful demo or benchmark.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority test: sponsor one developer-native story linked to an interactive demo or benchmark.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Use a visual system-design angle on high-volume data, real-time updates, or scalable enterprise front ends.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Paid niche test: use only with a strong system-design or high-volume data architecture asset.

UITools_Placements.Audience: Cloud-native developers, platform engineers & tech leaders
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Pitch a technical how-to or sponsored article on performance, platform consistency, AI workflows, or developer productivity.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority paid route: pursue sponsored technical content supported by an engineering SME and code.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Use a concise paid ad promoting a practical .NET/Blazor benchmark, architecture guide, or downloadable sample.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: High priority for .NET/Blazor: book a paid slot around a benchmark, guide, or sample application.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Submit and verify each sellable product, then optimize categories, alternatives, screenshots, pricing, and links.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Quick win: submit and verify each sellable product, then optimize categories, alternatives, and links.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Confirm category fit, list products under exact website names, complete profiles, and request honest customer reviews.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Secondary buyer channel: confirm category fit, complete eligible profiles, and request honest reviews.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Pitch an original practitioner article with production evidence, technical depth, and clear actionable lessons.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Strategic earned target: pitch production-backed technical lessons; expect a selective editorial process.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Pitch a useful React resource—demo, benchmark, migration guide, or meaningful open-source release.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Strong React option: sponsor a useful demo or guide; use editorial outreach for major ecosystem value.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Use only for a genuine Node/backend story such as APIs, real-time data, exports, or performance under load.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Opportunistic: use only when the campaign has a credible Node.js, API, or backend angle.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Submit a polished tool or major release with clear use case, docs, install path, demo, and proof of active maintenance.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Selective earned target: submit only a polished new tool, major release, or meaningful open-source launch.

UITools_Placements.Audience: Developers and technical buyers evaluating data grids
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Request neutral inclusion with complete product facts, reproducible tests, pricing, licensing, accessibility, and support details.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Direct action: request neutral inclusion with complete product facts and reproducible comparison evidence.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Only suggest topics backed by original engineering data, real customer outcomes, and credible practitioner sources.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Monitor only: suggest a topic only when backed by original data and credible practitioner sources.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Competitor-owned: track claims and keywords, then publish an evidence-based Infragistics alternative page.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Monitor only: use competitor claims to guide an evidence-based Infragistics alternative page.

UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Request inclusion using verifiable npm data, release cadence, bundle size, licensing, framework support, and benchmarks.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Low-cost outreach: request inclusion or corrections using verifiable package and benchmark data.

UITools_Placements.Audience: React developers evaluating table and grid libraries
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Competitor-owned: monitor claims and publish a transparent Infragistics comparison using reproducible benchmarks.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Monitor only: track claims and respond through stronger owned comparison and benchmark content.

UITools_Placements.Audience: React developers evaluating UI and grid alternatives
UITools_Placements.Angle / who to pitch: Competitor-owned: monitor positioning, correct major inaccuracies, and strengthen owned comparison content.
UITools_Placements.Recommendation: Monitor only: correct material inaccuracies and strengthen Infragistics-owned comparison pages.
